generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a C++20 command-line G-code simulator under `output/`, buildable with:

- `cmake -B output/build output && cmake --build output/build`

Binary:

- `output/build/simulator`

Supported CLI (per your harness requirements):

- `--input <gcode_file> --output <result_file>`
- Optional: `--tool-table`, `--block-delete`, `--carousel-slots`, `--parameter-input`, `--parameter-output`
- Optional trace: `--trace-output` plus exactly one of `--trace-time-step | --trace-distance-step | --trace-position-tolerance`

Key files:

- `output/src/main.cpp` (CLI entry)
- `output/src/cli.{h,cpp}` (arg parsing/validation)
- `output/src/gcode_parser.{h,cpp}` + `output/src/expression.{h,cpp}` (RS274 line parsing + expressions/params)
- `output/src/executor.cpp` (execution + trace sampling)
- `output/src/serialize.{h,cpp}` + `output/src/trace.{h,cpp}` + `output/src/json.{h,cpp}` (JSON output + trace delta encoding)
- `output/src/tool_table.{h,cpp}`, `output/src/parameter_file.{h,cpp}` (RS274 tool/parameter file formats)
- `output/CMakeLists.txt`

comparison.note: Same node IDs can have corrected fixtures/assertions; transitions describe these rubric revisions, not repeated trials of an unchanged test suite.

provenance.availability: Portable score summary, not a complete regrade bundle. Raw regrade JSON, source/test snapshots and pytest reports were produced in a scratch working directory on the auditing workstation and are not committed.
